Table with column alignment attributes

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<table><thead><tr><th align=\"left\">Left</th><th align=\"center\">Center</th><th align=\"right\">Right</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>L</td><td>C</td><td>R</td></tr></tbody></table>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
